title: Why Airlines Sell Your Seat Twice
topic: Why airlines sell more tickets than seats
mechanism: Seats perish at takeoff and a predictable share of passengers never show, so revenue systems sell extra tickets and buy seats back (or bump people) on the rare days everyone shows up.

beats.hook: You and a stranger both hold seat 14C
beats.story: A sleeper on the same flight hits snooze; you rush to the gate early
beats.rise: You feel safe; the agent asks for volunteers
beats.twist: The agent calls your name: you are the one bumped
beats.mechanism: Milk-carton seat that expires at takeoff, no-show board, SELL +16 button, seat-count screen, voucher desk, 4x fare label
beats.ending: You take the voucher; the sleeper books tomorrow's flight, seat 14C
